answer: Problem: farms spin falcon-fast sockpuppet graders that flood peer panels before bonds settle. Mechanism: each seat must post a quartz-weight escrow keyed to a bridge-scoped nullifier from the epoch seed, then publish a one-shot work receipt peers rehash before the seat votes. Cost: clones burn unique escrow and drafting labor per ID, so mass minting scales linearly. Verification: peers recompute the nullifier and receipt hash against the beacon-free epoch seed on-ledger. Failure: if bridge-scope checks are skipped, recycled receipts cross seats and the panel collapses into template spam.
